text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So this is... the end of the line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The adventure across the world of the new 
RPG, which I had journeyed through 
alongside Agnes Digital and the others, 
was finally about to draw to a close.
choice_data_list: The final boss, the Demon King, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've made it this far! Our levels 
are maxed, and our gear is top-notch. The 
ending's right around the corner, ain't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaahn... Tap-san, so charming... Better 
get ready to record the ending...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With high spirits, the party shoved open 
the great doors, fully determined to bring 
down the Demon King. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Shoot!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Pitiful creatures. To think you 
would dare challenge and attempt to 
shatter my perpetual end of days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Demon King was utterly ferocious. 
Freely manipulating the battlefield's 
traits, he crushed every single strategy 
we threw at him.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First magic sealing, now stat 
inversion...!? Dammit! Stop switchin' up 
your tactics every two seconds, ya 
bastard...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...This game was a prototype, if I recall? 
Fufufu, to speak on a meta level, I have 
no choice but to call this a gross balance 
oversight by the developers.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, don't go killin' the buzz. 
...Though honestly, I ain't got a clue how 
to beat 'im either...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna see everyone get showered with 
praise in the glorious ending scene...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I must worship it. Burn it into my 
retinas. And for that reason... To break 
through this wall, I... I will...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: NEVER! GIVE! UP!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAHH!! Like hell I'm retreating 
before I collect my oshi's ending CG and 
unlock all achievementsーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me! But there's no stopping me 
now!! I just HAVE to witness my oshi's 
True Hero Ending, with my own two eyes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, everyone!! Yours truly, 
Digi-tan, has cooked up a master plan!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A plan, huh... Man, you really are pretty 
crazy.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...But hell, I totally dig how you pull 
off that absolute madness for real. Count 
me in!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
Still struggling...? Then perish—within my 
eternal century!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(A multi-hit barrage...! Counter that with 
Thief speed boost!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Digital! Let's dance together on 
the ocean stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Tap-san's Pirate skill shifted the field 
to the Ocean Stage! And now trigger "Water 
Walking"! We can move completely 
unrestricted!)
choice_data_list:
Triggering a skill from another job class 
too!? Talk about evolution...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew♪ You actually synced right up with 
me! ...It's almost frustrating how I can't 
take my eyes off ya, partner!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital was evolving ceaselessly. At 
this very moment, right here on the 
battlefield... she kept mastering whatever 
it took to seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Time for the last dance! Take my hand, 
Hero!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right! Take this... and—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Hero??

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaaaahhhh... Im... possible... How 
could this beee...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's over. Wait, um, did you just 
call me... the Hero?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, ain't that just a fact? Take a look 
for yourself.

text_block_list.name: System
text_block_list.text:
"GAME CLEAR! Agnes Digital: Thief. Title: 
[Almighty Hero]"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...WHAAAAT!? Why meee!?!?
choice_data_list:
Well, considering how much you carried the 
team, who else?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even count how many times our 
Hero came to our rescue... Right? It's an 
ending we can all agree on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah. Come on, puff your chest out! 
You're the top dog now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A hero who broke the very concept of role 
aptitude, performing wonders across every 
conceivable scenario... ...Fufufu, sounds 
rather fitting, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...!! This is a bug!! I'm... I'm supposed 
to be just a fly on the waaaall~~!!
